import pytest
from pydantic import BaseModel
from llm_router._internal.capabilities.schema import normalize_schema

pytestmark = pytest.mark.verification_kind("unit")

class Answer(BaseModel):
    summary: str
    score: int

@pytest.mark.verifies("REQ_STRUCTURED_SCHEMA_CONTRACT[revision==2]")
def test_pydantic_spec_returns_existing_model_instance_unchanged() -> None:
    instance = Answer(summary="all good", score=42)
    spec = normalize_schema(Answer)

    result = spec.parse(instance)

    assert result is instance
    assert isinstance(result, Answer)
